archetypes.name: resume-state
archetypes.rationale: Targets pause/resume sentinel and recovery-marker plan gaps that static reviewers may only cover generically.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the plan correctly identifies every writer and reader of Step 5c completion state, pause markers, and recovery metadata. Check for plan-vs-repo mismatches around resume re-entry, skipped publish, failed publish, and valid recovery-branch paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: envelope-contracts
archetypes.rationale: Focuses on shell envelope and exit-code contract drift across publish, pause, render, and docs surfaces.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the proposed exit-code and stdout-envelope semantics against the existing script contracts, caller expectations, and sibling documentation. Look for places where the plan changes structural argv failures, operational failures, or recovery envelopes without updating all dependent callers and tests. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: summary-ops
archetypes.rationale: Catches operator-facing summary defects such as misleading approved states, fake run-log paths, and degraded fallback drift.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the plan fully covers operator-visible publish outcomes in both primary and fallback summary renderers. Check that skipped, failed, and approved states remain distinguishable and that no synthetic success paths or recovery instructions appear when no publish occurred. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
